indication: Unresectable or metastatic gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
qualifying_population: Adults with a PDGFRA exon 18 mutation including D842V
Adults with aggressive systemic mastocytosis or systemic mastocytosis with an associated hematological neoplasm or mast cell leukemia; not recommended if platelet count is below 50 × 10^9/L
Adults with indolent systemic mastocytosis; not recommended if platelet count is below 50 × 10^9/L
